scenes.text: You're planning a cold store for potato growers. Where should you investigate first?
Search your area and choose cold storage. Here, we open a saved analysis, so every step follows the same example.
Where first gives you a shortlist. Start with Kora Market, then ask why it deserves attention.
Harvest shows where crops may come from. These are estimates, built from production statistics and mapped homes.
Access follows roads and paths, not straight lines. Switch seasons to see how rain changes who can reach a site.
Energy shows mapped power lines and a possible solar option. Nearby power does not confirm a working connection. That still needs checking.
Open the site card. This example estimates electricity needed on a busy harvest day. The range shows how much that estimate could change.
How sure repeats the comparison with 300 sets of assumptions. See which sites stay near the top, and which need closer attention.
Likely sites finds places resembling known facilities. These are leads to check, not confirmed businesses.
Map data reveals gaps. Sources shows where information came from. Unknown does not mean nothing is there.
Export the shortlist. Save the analysis. Before investing, check crop volumes, power supply, and local conditions.
A clearer shortlist. Reasons you can inspect. A practical next step.
